thr_orbit_001.text:
Hi Aditya,

First pass of the onboarding flow is in Figma: https://figma.example/orbit/onboarding-v1

Five screens, as agreed at kickoff: Welcome, phone verification, PIN setup, permissions, and a five-card tour. These are wireframes, not final visuals. I'm still on track for the finished onboarding screens by the 19th.

Two things I'd like a call on:
1. The tour is five cards. Is that too many for field agents?
2. PIN setup is a 4-digit PIN. Meridian's summary deck didn't specify a length.

Rahul, cc'ing you so you see the screen inventory early.

Sana

Sana,

Approved, with one change: cut the tour from five cards to three. The agents will swipe past five; three they might read. Everything else stands.

4-digit PIN is fine. Meridian confirmed a 4-digit PIN on the summary call, keep it.

Aditya

Three cards is also less work for me, so no complaints.

One question: does the permissions screen ask for location? Offline sync doesn't need it, and Meridian's agents will say no anyway.

Rahul

No location. The permissions screen asks for camera and notifications only. Camera for the inspection photos, notifications for sync status.

Updating the tour to three cards now. Final screens still by the 19th.

Sana

Good. Closing this thread, see you Monday.

Aditya

thr_orbit_002.text:
Aditya,

Quick heads-up on the UPI flow, as promised yesterday: I'm not waiting for Monday.

I submitted the Razorpay merchant KYC for UPI autopay mandates this morning. Their support just confirmed it takes five business days for sandbox mandate activation, not three. That puts the unlock on Thursday the 24th at the earliest, and I need two full days after that to test mandates against real callbacks.

So I'm moving the UPI flow from Friday the 25th to Monday the 28th. The one-time UPI path already works and will be on staging by Friday the 25th regardless; this move is only about mandates.

Rahul, cc'ing you because your shell tests against staging, not against my branch, so your dates don't change.

Priya

Priya,

Acknowledged. The UPI flow is Monday the 28th. Noted on the board.

That is the second move on this one (24th, 25th, now 28th). Decision: if it moves again, we cut UPI autopay mandates from the October release and ship one-time UPI only. I would rather ship less than ship late.

Thanks for not waiting for Monday.

Aditya

Fine by me. I test against staging, so the 25th is the date I care about.

If mandates do get cut, tell me early so I can hide the autopay toggle rather than ship a dead button.

Rahul

Will do. You'll know on Thursday the 24th either way; that's when the KYC unlocks, or doesn't.

Priya

thr_orbit_003.text:
Hello Farah,

Rahul here, I'm building the Orbit mobile app for the Meridian pilot. Sana's review of your accessibility checklist found that our planned bottom tab bar gives about 48 dp per tab on your 5-inch rugged devices, below your minimum. We decided on Wednesday to replace it with a side drawer.

Before I build it, two questions on the checklist:
1. Is 56 dp a hard minimum for primary navigation targets, or a recommendation?
2. Does a side drawer satisfy the single-landmark rule if it opens from a 56 dp button in the top bar and is announced as navigation?

Mockup of the drawer attached (orbit-drawer-mockup-v1.pdf). Aditya mentioned you need to sign it off; happy to adjust.

Thanks,
Rahul

Dear Rahul,

Thank you for checking before building; most vendors do not.

1. 56 dp is a hard minimum (checklist section 4.2, Primary navigation targets). It comes from our field study with gloved agents and is not negotiable for the pilot.
2. Yes. A side drawer satisfies section 4.5 provided the trigger is at least 56 dp, the drawer is announced as Navigation to TalkBack, and focus moves into the drawer when it opens. Your mockup does all three.

Please consider the drawer mockup approved by Meridian Bank compliance as of today. The tab bar proposal would not have passed.

We will have further items for the payment flows on the call on the 23rd with Aditya and Priya.

Kind regards,
Farah Siddiqui
Compliance, Meridian Bank

Farah, thank you. We will treat this as the formal sign-off on the drawer mockup. Rahul, that closes my commitment to get the mockup signed off by today.

Sana, please add sections 4.2 and 4.5 to our design review template.

Aditya

Thanks Farah, that's exactly what I needed. Building it now; the side drawer will be in the app by Wednesday the 23rd as planned.

Rahul

Added 4.2 and 4.5 to the template. I also re-measured the onboarding buttons at 56 dp against her numbers; they pass.

Sana

thr_orbit_004.text:
Hi Nikhil,

I wanted you to hear this from us directly. Our launch customer, Meridian Bank, mandates PayU as the payment provider for the Orbit pilot; their compliance team confirmed it yesterday and will not onboard a second provider. Orbit's payments service is therefore moving from Razorpay to PayU for the October release.

Two requests:
1. Please keep our sandbox account open until at least October 1st. We are finishing the one-time UPI flow and the autopay mandate tests against it (merchant KYC came through this morning, thank you) and will swap the provider underneath afterwards.
2. Please don't close the merchant account. We have a second prospect, Kestrel Logistics, and no vendor constraint there yet.

Nothing about your team's support caused this. It's the customer's licence.

Regards,
Priya

Hi Priya,

Understood, and thank you for telling us rather than going quiet. Confirming:
- Sandbox access stays open for 90 days from today, so well past October 1st.
- The merchant account stays active at no cost. KYC is complete, so Kestrel or any future project can go live without repeating it.

If Meridian's position changes, we'd be glad to talk about a joint integration. Also, the UPI collect callback issue you reported on the 11th is fixed in sandbox as of yesterday, for what it's worth.

Best,
Nikhil Rao
Account Manager, Razorpay

Nikhil, appreciated. For the record on our side: the Orbit payments service uses PayU for the October release, superseding our kickoff decision on Razorpay, because Meridian Bank's compliance team mandates it. We'll come back to you for Kestrel if their compliance allows.

Aditya

Internal only, Nikhil dropped.

PayU sandbox keys arrived. Their UPI callbacks fire within two seconds, so the polling workaround goes away. PayU integration still on for Thursday, October 1st.

Rahul, the Razorpay SDK can come out of the shell whenever; staging already points at the provider interface.

Priya

SDK's out as of this morning. Two files and a gradle line. Done.

Rahul
